description: flush-union's second box pushed four tolerances (4e-7) into the first, fused: one box 80 long, but where the two boxes' side faces overlap on their four common planes the strip between x = 40 − 4e-7 and x = 40 is a face of its own, 4e-7 wide, four tolerances apart from its edges' — Arris keeps what it is given apart by more than a tolerance. The union is a box 80 − 4e-7 long, volume 24000 − 300·4e-7 = 23999.99988 and area 7000 − 80·4e-7 = 6999.999968 in closed form, which Open CASCADE's reading of Arris's STEP gives to 1e-11; Open CASCADE's own fuse measures 23999.99984 and 6999.99996, the far side, so the fixture states volume 3e-9 and area 2e-9 against its 1.7e-9 and 1.1e-9 (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 9, the band's ends).

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE merges the 4e-7 strip where the two boxes' side faces overlap into the faces beside it (12/20/10/10); Arris keeps it, its two edges four tolerances apart
